CustomObject.description: Durable operational log for RenewalIQ. Written by RIQ_Logger through RIQ_Log_Event__e, which is published immediately so a line survives a rolled-back transaction. Never contains API keys, tokens, email addresses, phone numbers or signal notes: RIQ_Logger redacts them first. Retention is enforced by RIQ_LogCleanupBatch.
CustomObject.label: RenewalIQ Log
